extension.summary: Find and remove TV-box botnets (XCPE, BADBOX 3.0, Vo1d, Kimwolf, JackSkid) from this Android box
extension.description: Antivirus-style cleaner for the botnets preinstalled on or pushed to cheap Android TV boxes: XCPE (Videostrong / MECOOL), BADBOX 2.0 and 3.0 (TXCZ), Vo1d, Kimwolf/Aisuru, JackSkid, and the proxyware they load. Connects to the box's own ADB (turn on USB debugging and ADB over network first), removes confirmed threats automatically and verifies with a re-scan. Lookalike app names and vendor firmware are only reported. IOCs: Google, Synthient, Plume, TrendAI, HUMAN, Nokia, Dr.Web, XLab, Unit 42, Comcast (to November 2026).
